title: 第五章 兄弟你好香求追读第六章 祸不单行感谢夜有月光的盟主
lines: “什么鬼？”
愕然中，季觉心头一紧，不由得紧张起来。
有贼？
那可太稀奇了！
毕竟自己家穷成这样，有贼来了可能都要含两包眼泪出门去，要是稍微有点良心，走之前可能还要在桌子上压两百块钱让孩子好好学习，努力读书。
北山区位于崖城外围，要说高精尖一样没有，要说脏乱差，从没输过。
非法移民、黑帮、走私乃至凶杀……混乱不堪的同时，凶案数量历年以来都稳居崖城各区的榜一，排名之稳定，总督来了都得叫声老头儿！
而季觉家这座老屋，说饱经沧桑都算夸奖，阴天漏雨，夏天漏风，白天漏水晚上漏电，一身毛病就从来没好过，哪怕用脚后跟去看都不像是什么有钱人家。
以至于这么多年了，就算偶尔有两次遇到毛贼，大家进门看看这家徒四壁的样子，也都同情的说声打扰了掉头就走。
季觉弯下腰，从床底下抽出半根钢筋来，小心翼翼的踩着嘎吱嘎吱作响的地板，下了一楼，左右窥探，比贼还心虚。
可除了被破坏了的门把手和一行穿过客厅没入了厨房的脚印之外，根本什么都没看见。
出来！
老兄，你找错地方了，我家没钱！”
这里除了一个比你还能吃能睡能懒的脆皮大学生之外什么都没有！
季觉探头，厨房里，只有被拽开了两扇门的冰箱，正对着他敞露出里面感人落泪的剩菜，门后的灯管明灭，奄奄一息一如这台三十多岁的电冰箱本身。
季觉如遭雷击！
眼泪都快下来了。
贼不走空就算了，怎么连自己前天从陆妈那里提回来的半盘白切鸡都给毛走了？！
他还打算过两天过生日的时候加个菜呢！
“没人性啊丢雷老谋！”
他看着盘子残留下来黑指印，再忍不住骂人，可看着空空荡荡的厨房，还有那扇临街敞开的窗户，哪儿能不知道贼早就跑路了，不由得痛恨起来。
早知道黑恶势力的目的是自己冰箱里的白切鸡，他早就抡起钢筋来和小偷做斗争了，哪里还至于心惊胆战这么久！
结果把自己的电冰箱都搞坏了！
而就在他摸到电冰箱门的那一瞬间，电机如老牛一般的嗡嗡声里，响起了预料之外的话语：“小心身后。”
那一瞬间，季觉猛然回头。
扑面而来的腥风里，看到了一双猩红色的眼睛。
在看着他。
饥肠辘辘……
就在厨房入口的大门上面，天花板和墙壁的夹缝里，像是蜘蛛一样诡异佝偻的人影，蠕动着，嘴里嘎嘣嘎嘣的咀嚼着最后的残骨。
锐利的牙齿像是刀锋一样，令人胆寒。
而在看清那个人影面目的瞬间，季觉再忍不住，尖叫出声。
“你……你是昨天那个老登！
可不是么？
那张老脸他可记的清清楚楚！
分明就是那个蹬着三轮车死不要命来创自己的老头儿，差点害自己直接走流程异界转生……当时局面太混乱了，也没人发现他是什么时候溜了，季觉也没放在心上，结果却没想到他竟然敢闯进自己家里来！
只不过，那模样看着，比昨天的样子，却又诡异的太多。
突出一个拟人。
不知道吃错了什么药。
“好啊，你居然还敢再来！
可就吃定我了是吧？！”
content_en:
"What the hell?"
In shock, Ji Jue's heart tightened and he couldn't help but become nervous.
Is there a thief?
That's so strange!
After all, my family is so poor that if a thief comes, I may have to leave home with two bags of tears in my eyes. If I have a little conscience, I may have to put two hundred yuan on the table before leaving so that my children can study hard and study hard.
Beishan District is located on the outskirts of Yacheng. It is neither sophisticated nor sophisticated, but dirty and messy. It has never lost.
Illegal immigration, gangs, smuggling and even murder... While the situation is chaotic, the number of murders has consistently ranked first among all districts in Yacheng over the years. The ranking is so stable that the governor has to call him "old man" when he comes!
As for the old house of Ji Jue's house, it would be a compliment to say that it has gone through many vicissitudes of life. It leaks rain on cloudy days, wind leaks in summer, water leaks during the day and electricity leaks at night. It has never gotten better. Even if you look at it with your heels, it doesn't look like a wealthy family.
So many years later, even if we occasionally encountered thieves twice, when everyone came in to see the bare house, they would all sympathize and say "Sorry for bothering you" and turn around and leave.
Ji Jue bent down and pulled out half a steel bar from under the bed. He carefully stepped on the creaking floor and went down to the first floor, peeking around. He felt more guilty than a thief.
But except for the broken door handle and a line of footprints that passed through the living room and into the kitchen, there was nothing at all.
"Hey!
Come out!
Dude, you are looking in the wrong place, my family has no money! "
There is nothing here except a crispy college student who can eat, sleep and be lazy better than you!
Ji Jue peeked his head in. In the kitchen, there was only a refrigerator with two doors pulled open, exposing to him the heart-wrenching leftovers inside. The light tube behind the door was on and off, and it was as dying as the thirty-year-old refrigerator itself.
Ji Jueru was struck by lightning!
Tears are almost coming.
Even if the thief didn't escape, why did he even get away with half the plate of plain-cut chicken that he brought back from Mother Lu the day before yesterday? !
He also plans to add a dish to his birthday in two days!
"Inhumane, Diulei Laomou!"
He looked at the black fingerprints left on the plate and couldn't help but curse. But looking at the empty kitchen and the open window facing the street, he couldn't help but realize that the thief had escaped long ago, and he couldn't help but feel resentful.
If he had known that the evil forces were after the plain-cut chicken in his refrigerator, he would have picked up steel bars to fight against the thieves. How could he have been frightened for so long!
As a result, my refrigerator was damaged!
And the moment he touched the refrigerator door, unexpected words rang out from the hum of the motor like an old cow: "Watch your back."
At that moment, Ji Jue turned around suddenly.
In the fishy wind that hit his face, he saw a pair of scarlet eyes.
Looking at him.
Hungry...
Just above the entrance door of the kitchen, in the gap between the ceiling and the wall, a strange and hunched figure like a spider was squirming, chewing the last remaining bones in its mouth.
The sharp teeth are like blades, which is terrifying.
The moment he saw the figure clearly, Ji Jue couldn't help it anymore and screamed.
"You...you are the old man from yesterday!
! "
Isn't it?
He could remember that old face clearly!
It was clearly the old man who was riding a tricycle desperately to injure himself. He almost caused himself to go through the process of reincarnation in another world... The situation was too chaotic at that time, and no one noticed when he escaped. Ji Jue didn't take it to heart, but he didn't expect that he would dare to break into his home!
However, that look was much weirder than yesterday's look.
Highlight a personification.
I don’t know what medicine I took wrongly.
"Okay, how dare you come again!
But you’re going to have me, right? ! "
title_en: Chapter 5: Brother, you are so sweet. Please read Chapter 6: Misfortunes never come singly. Thank you to the leader of the moonlit night.
